create_qwen2vl_processor: create a Qwen2VLProcessor instance with image_processor, tokenizer, and optional video_processor
run_qwen2vl_processor_call: run the Qwen2VLProcessor __call__ method to tokenize text with embedded images and videos
build_multimodal_token_count: build the number of multimodal placeholder tokens for given image and video sizes

review_model_input_names: review the model_input_names property to list all supported model input fields
